entries.topic: Why the accusation stops the conversation

claims.text: Eisenberger, Lieberman, Williams (Science, 10 Oct 2003): Cyberball exclusion activated the anterior cingulate cortex like physical pain; right ventral prefrontal activity reduced it; Lieberman: rejection 'appears to register automatically in the brain'.
Plant and Devine (1998), internal and external motivation to respond without prejudice, JPSP 75(3):811.
Dixon (2023): Goleman coined 'amygdala hijack' in 1995; amygdala works in concert with the prefrontal cortex; 'probably does not hijack your brain'.
FIRE/College Pulse 2025 rankings: 58,807 students, 257 schools, Jan-Jun 2024; 55% say the Israeli-Palestinian conflict is hard to discuss openly (26% prior year), the top topic.
Ovadia Yosef, 16 Oct 2010 sermon: 'Goyim were born only to serve us'; AJC: 'abhorrent and an offense to human dignity'.

entries.topic: The Khazar question: who told the story

claims.text: Stampfer, 'Did the Khazars Convert to Judaism?', Jewish Social Studies 19(3) 2013: correspondence and Schechter letter unreliable, Sallam and Patriarch Nicholas silent, almost no Jewish artifacts; conversion 'a legend with no factual basis'; Kuzari, Dunlop, Koestler, Sand relied on it.
Stampfer: 'The silence of so many sources about the Khazars' Judaism is very suspicious.'
Sand, Invention of the Jewish People (2008): Khazar descent; 19 weeks on Israel's bestseller list; Bartal and Shapira ('The Jewish-People Deniers') critical.

JTA 2026: Hungarian Jews embraced the theory in the 19th c.; Koestler 1976; Sand; Elhaik; Carlson-Huckabee interview 19 Feb 2026 ('genetic testing on everybody in the land'); Huckabee 'dangerous conspiracy theory'; Owens 'Khazarian Turks'; Netanyahu not reported to respond; Stampfer 'nonsense'; 2013 study 'no evidence ... of a Khazar origin'.

Ancient genomes of nine elite Khazar-period burials: mainly Central Asian/Turkic steppe with Siberian, East Asian, some Caucasus ancestry; no significant Ashkenazi affinity; mitochondrial haplotypes absent in present-day Ashkenazim.
Kornienko et al. (Russian Journal of Genetics 2021): Y-haplogroups of nine Khazar elite burials 7th-9th c.: R1a 3, C2b 2, G2a, N1a, Q, R1b one each.

Solzhenitsyn, Two Hundred Years Together, ch. 1: Khazar elite conversion c. 732 (citing Bruzkus); captives settled in Kiev's 'Kosary' quarter; Harkavy's Black Sea origin; western settlers invited into Poland.
Das, Wexler et al. (GBE 2016) placed Ashkenazi ancestry near 'Ashkenaz' villages in eastern Turkey; rebuttal argues the GPS method cannot trace admixed populations and Yiddish is Germanic.
Rabbinate: DNA verification for some immigrants seeking to marry, mainly from the former USSR; gained momentum 2017.

entries.topic: States that guard founding stories by law

claims.text: Israel, Amendment 40 Budgets Foundations Law (Nakba Law), March 2011, 37-25; funding cuts for marking Independence Day as mourning; Supreme Court Jan 2012 dismissed petition as premature.
Turkey: Pamuk said 'thirty-thousand Kurds and one million Armenians were killed' (Feb 2005); charged under Article 301 'insulting Turkishness'; up to four years.

Poland's 2018 law on blaming the Polish nation for Nazi crimes; 27 Jun 2018 amended to civil offense under US pressure and vocal Israeli opposition; Yad Vashem chief historian called it 'morally and historically flawed'.
PEN America (Nov 2023): 40 educational gag orders law or policy since 2021 in 22 states; ~1.3m K-12 teachers affected.
